column3: MT 76:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew.
Close to the Hebrew; סֻכּוֹ (“his lair, booth”) is rendered “His tabernacle,” and “his den” “His dwelling place.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the flames of the bow” is rendered “the arrows of the bow.”
Close to the Hebrew; נָאוֹר (“resplendent”) is rendered “more glorious and excellent.”
Close to the Hebrew; “have not found their hands” is rendered “have found the use of their hands.”
Close to the Hebrew; “were in deep sleep” is rendered “were cast into a dead sleep.”
Close to the Hebrew; כָּל־ עַנְוֵי־ (“the humble”) is rendered “all the oppressed.”
Close to the Hebrew; “to the awesome one” is rendered “to Him who ought to be feared.”
Close to the Hebrew; יִבְצֹר (“cuts off”) is rendered “He shall cut off.”
